summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AMREST Transformer ERP & CRM (FastAPI+Mongo backend, React SPA with single-JSONB state). All 11 pytest cases passed and all frontend flows in the review request work as expected.

design_issues.screen: Quotations page (and any page rendering <Select> with dynamic <option>)
issues: React hydration warning in dev: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>`. This is triggered by Emergent's React instrumentation injecting an x-excluded <span> inside <option> elements produced from array map. Non-fatal but pollutes the console.

After logout, the version-poll interval fires once more before the effect unmounts, producing a transient 401 in console. Harmless but noisy. Consider gating fetches inside the interval on `getToken() != null`.

action_items: Optional: fix the React 'span cannot be child of option' hydration warning by rendering option children as plain strings (no wrapper components in .map keys); low priority.
Optional: guard the 15s polling interval in store.tsx with a token check to avoid post-logout 401 in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Security: user passwords are stored in plain text in the Mongo doc and compared plainly in /api/auth/login. This is documented as intentional v1 demo behavior but must be replaced with bcrypt/argon2 before any real deployment.

Data model: the entire ERP state is stored as one giant document under _id='amrest-main'. PUT /api/erp/state is last-writer-wins with no optimistic concurrency check (client can overwrite a newer server version). Consider passing expected `version` on PUT and returning 409 on mismatch.
Backend: no rate-limit / lockout on /api/auth/login; brute-force of any of the 7 seeded weak passwords is trivial.
Frontend: token stored in localStorage under `amrest_erp_token` (XSS-exposed). Acceptable for v1 demo but flag for prod.

Testability: interactive elements (sidebar buttons, KPI cards, forms) do not carry data-testid attributes, only input `name` attributes and visible text. Adding data-testid on Layout nav buttons, Login submit, logout, and Dashboard KPI tiles will make future tests far more robust.
server.py mixes concerns (seed data + auth + state) in a single 234-line file; still under the 700-line threshold but will grow quickly if further endpoints are added.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, rohit/sales123, priya/sales123, production/prod123, purchase/purchase123, testing/test123, store/store123 (all verified working).
seed_data_creation: None created. Seed users/settings are produced by backend's seed_state() on first login/state read; test added and cleaned up a TEST_marker key in settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under test: GET /api/, POST /api/auth/login, GET/PUT /api/erp/state, GET /api/erp/version. Backend URL is `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}` from /app/frontend/.env (currently https://production-central-8.preview.emergentagent.com). JWT tokens are Bearer, stored in localStorage key `amrest_erp_token`. Frontend Login inputs are `input[name=amrest-login-username]` / `input[name=amrest-login-password]`; submit is `button[type=submit]`. No data-testid attributes yet. Admin sidebar has 21 items (Profile is accessed via header avatar). Sales role sees exactly 7 sidebar items.
verified_features: All 7 seed users can log in
GET /api/erp/state with bearer -> data{users,parties,items,settings} + numeric version
PUT /api/erp/state increments version and persists; subsequent GET returns updated payload and higher version

Login UI renders at root; admin/admin123 lands on Dashboard with KPI cards, Monthly Sales chart, Monthly Production chart, Inventory by Category donut, Top Customers, Low Stock Alerts, Recent Quotations, Recent Activity
Admin sidebar renders all admin modules; clicks on Party Master, Item Master, Quotations, Bill of Material, Job Cards, Production, QC Testing, Users all render without page errors
Sales login rohit/sales123 restricts sidebar to: Dashboard, Sales CRM, Party Master, Quotations, Proforma Invoices, Sales Orders, Reports (matches permission spec)
Refresh preserves session (state hydrates via token + amrest_erp_session)
Wrong-password login surfaces 'Invalid credentials' inline error
